scientific_integrity: The analytical argument proves the exact projection formula and the uniform sharp sparse-orbit law; 119 finite numerical checks are supporting reproducibility, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Results concern regular-polygon value/first-derivative kernel orbits and single normalized monomials in the classical Gaussian Fock space; no arbitrary-site or multi-degree optimization is asserted. The two near-optimal radius shells are asymptotic only. Historical coherent-state circle sources were not available in complete text, leaving a priority risk.
title: Two optimal radii for sparse first-jet sampling of Gaussian Fock monomials
